categories.link_state: a fact about the control link right now; the same ask a moment later may well be written
categories.permanent: a settled fact — the ask was wrong, the id is spent, or the outcome is already recorded
categories.transient_local: this Mac's own store or lookup failed BEFORE anything was written; nothing reached Codex and the same ask may well succeed on a retry
categories.wire_code: the app-server or the broker refused the write; the sentence carries their numeric code and never their message

tokens.{agent}: the name of an agent kind this build does not support
tokens.{err}: a local store error, rendered by this Mac and never by Codex
tokens.{max}: a ceiling this build enforces (today only MAX_COMPOSE_BYTES)
tokens.{n}: a number — the size of the thing asked about, or a wire error code
tokens.{ref}: the session reference the caller used (a uid or a tmux name)
tokens.{status}: a turn terminal's own status word from the wire
tokens.{word}: an outcome word read back from the ledger that this build has no vocabulary for

what: Every sentence ccd can send a phone when a Codex interrupt or compose did not happen. Emitted from mac/ccd/src/codex_refusals.rs, which is the single place each sentence is written; ccd's own gate test requires this file to be byte-identical to what the build emits.
